heading: Keep the next step in sight.
intro: Loan coordination for the documents, reminders, pipeline updates, and handoffs that keep your team moving. Clear files. Considered follow-up. A named owner for what happens next.
serviceHeading: Support for every turn of the file.
serviceIntro: Choose from eight administrative services across intake, processing support, closing preparation, and post-close records. Lending judgment stays with your licensed team.
label: Loan coordination support
statement: A file moves better when nothing gets lost between people.
chapter: From “still waiting” to a clear next action.
body: An uploaded document is not the same as a reviewed document. An approaching milestone is not the same as a confirmed one. A coordinator keeps those distinctions visible and follows up with the person who can move the file forward.
exampleTitle: Follow a file through the handoff.
boundary: Your licensed professionals retain loan advice, eligibility, terms, underwriting, approval, and funding authority. Coordination covers approved administrative updates and routes lending questions to the right owner.
closing: Bring the file that keeps getting stuck.
faq: Can a coordinator work with several loan officers?
Yes. Agree the shared queue, priority rules, workload, and named owner for each file so urgent requests do not obscure other commitments.
Only through the channels and templates your team approves. Questions about terms, rates, eligibility, or approval return to licensed staff.
Can we keep our loan origination system?
Yes. Set approved permissions, naming conventions, document-handling rules, and the source of truth for milestone status.
learn: Practical notes for a more organized loan process.

services.title: Loan pipeline coordination
services.benefit: A shared view of every active file, its next action, and the person responsible.
tasks: Reconcile file stages against the approved loan system
Maintain milestone dates and accountable owners
Separate waiting-on-borrower items from internal blockers
Prepare a daily exception list for the loan team
deliverables: Dated handoff to each file owner
prep: Current pipeline export and stage definitions
Approved LOS access and reporting cadence
services.example: A file has received documents but still shows an old pipeline stage. The coordinator records the received date, flags the mismatch to the processor, and keeps the next milestone visible until the authorized owner confirms the update.

faq.question: Can a coordinator mark a loan approved?
faq.answer: No. Approval and underwriting status must come from an authorized source. Coordination keeps that status visible without making the decision.

services.photoAlt: Professionals reviewing records together at a laptop

services.title: Document request support
services.benefit: Make outstanding document requests clear without asking borrowers to send the same item twice.
tasks: Build checklists from processor-approved requests
Record receipt dates and document versions
Send approved reminders through the secure channel
Route missing, unreadable, or mismatched items for review
prep: Secure upload destination and naming rules
services.example: A borrower uploads two versions of an income document. The coordinator labels both by receipt date, records the unresolved version question, and asks the processor which version to retain for review.

faq.question: Does receipt mean a document is acceptable?
faq.answer: No. Receipt tracking is administrative. Your processor or underwriter decides whether a document satisfies the requirement.

services.photoAlt: A person completing and checking a document

services.title: Borrower communication support
services.benefit: Give borrowers consistent updates while keeping lending questions with licensed staff.
tasks: Maintain the approved contact schedule
Send authorized status messages and reminders
Record replies and promised callbacks
Route questions about rates, eligibility, or terms to licensed staff
services.example: A borrower replies to a document reminder with a question about their rate. The coordinator logs the question, arranges the approved callback, and leaves the rate explanation to the loan officer.

faq.question: Can messages be sent in our team’s voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply approved templates, sender permissions, and examples. New promises or changes to loan terms require your authorized review.

services.photoAlt: Office team handling communications at their computers

services.title: Processor workflow support
services.benefit: Keep conditions, internal requests, and handoffs organized around the processor’s working queue.
tasks: Maintain the processor-approved condition tracker
Attach references to received supporting records
Follow up with named internal owners
Prepare unresolved-item summaries before handoff
services.example: Before a processor handoff, the coordinator identifies three open requests, attaches the available source links, and lists the next owner for each. The processor retains all condition-clearance decisions.

faq.question: Can support clear underwriting conditions?
faq.answer: No. The coordinator tracks requests and supporting records. Your authorized processor or underwriter confirms satisfaction of conditions.

services.photoAlt: Colleagues handing over documents at a meeting

services.title: Closing coordination support
services.benefit: Bring appointment logistics and administrative dependencies into one current closing checklist.
tasks: Confirm approved appointment details with participants
Track closing-document readiness as reported by owners
Maintain title and internal contact information
Flag unresolved logistics before the planned closing
prep: Approved closing date and participant list
Rules for documenting readiness and changes
services.example: A closing appointment changes location. The coordinator confirms the new address with the authorized closing contact, updates the logistics brief, and records which participants have acknowledged it.

faq.question: Can a coordinator confirm wire instructions?
faq.answer: No. Funds movement and verification of wire instructions stay with your authorized closing and finance professionals through their established controls.

services.photoAlt: Professionals reviewing a document at a meeting

services.title: Post-close file support
services.benefit: Leave a searchable completion record after the closing team has finished its work.
tasks: Compare the file with the approved archive checklist
Label final documents and flag missing records
Maintain post-close requests and responsible owners
Record the approved archive location and handoff date
services.example: The close is complete but one signed record is absent from the archive folder. The coordinator records the gap, assigns the follow-up to the closing owner, and keeps the file marked incomplete for administrative handoff.

faq.question: Does this include a legal file audit?
faq.answer: No. This is checklist and document coordination. Legal sufficiency, retention policy, and compliance review remain with your qualified team.

services.photoAlt: Office professional organizing and reviewing folders

services.title: Partner update support
services.benefit: Keep title, insurance, and real estate partners informed through approved status updates.
tasks: Maintain a current partner contact roster
Prepare updates from approved file status
Track partner requests and response dates
Escalate conflicting information to the file owner
services.example: A title partner requests an update that conflicts with the internal tracker. The coordinator flags the discrepancy to the file owner before sending an update and records the confirmed status once approved.

faq.question: Can all file details be shared with partners?
faq.answer: Only the fields and recipients approved by your organization. Sensitive documents stay in the authorized channel with the appropriate access.

services.photoAlt: Professional reviewing a binder while using a headset

services.title: Loan intake administration
services.benefit: Keep new inquiries and application checklists ready for the licensed loan team.
tasks: Record inquiry details in the approved CRM
Check application checklists for missing administrative fields
Coordinate initial appointments and approved reminders
Route eligibility, rates, and product questions to licensed staff
prep: Approved intake fields and contact procedure
services.example: A new inquiry includes contact details but no preferred appointment time. Support requests availability using the approved message, records the response, and prepares the inquiry for the loan officer without discussing eligibility.

faq.question: Does intake support qualify a borrower?
faq.answer: No. Support records supplied information and coordinates the next step. Your licensed team determines eligibility, recommends products, and explains loan terms.
